questions.text: If each letter moves one step forward, CAT becomes DBU. How is DOG coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter moves +1: D→E, O→P, G→H = EPH.

questions.text: If DELHI is coded as EFMIJ (each letter one step forward), how is MUMBAI coded?
questions.explanation: M→N, U→V, M→N, B→C, A→B, I→J gives NVNCBJ.
questions.tip: Write the letters one under the other.

questions.text: Select the odd one out.
P is the sister of Q. Q is the son of R, and R is the wife of S. How is P related to S?
questions.explanation: R is S’s wife and Q is R’s son, so P (Q’s sister) is S’s daughter.

questions.text: A person walks 8 km north, then 6 km east, then 8 km south. Where is the person from the start?
questions.explanation: 8 km north and 8 km south cancel; 6 km east remains.

questions.text: If 1 March is a Monday in a non-leap year, what day is 1 April?
questions.explanation: March has 31 days = 4 weeks + 3 days; Monday + 3 = Thursday.
questions.tip: Month days ÷ 7: the remainder is the shift.

questions.text: A cube with all outer faces painted is cut into 27 equal small cubes. How many have exactly two painted faces?
questions.explanation: Two-faced cubes sit on the 12 edges, one per edge, so 12.

questions.text: C is taller than A, A is taller than B, and D is shorter than B. Who is the tallest?
questions.explanation: C > A > B > D, so C is tallest.

questions.text: P, Q, R, S, T stand in a row. P is left of Q, Q is left of R, T stands between Q and R, S is right of R. Who is in the middle?
questions.explanation: Order is P, Q, T, R, S, so the middle is T.
questions.tip: Draw five boxes and fill them.

questions.explanation: Doctors who are teachers are educated, so I follows; II says all doctors, which is not given.

questions.text: Select the grammatically correct sentence.

No sooner did the meeting began when the fire alarm rang.

questions.text: Passive form of: The manager approved the proposal.

The proposal has approve by the manager.

questions.text: Reported speech: She said, “I have finished my work.”
options: She said that I have finished my work.
She said that she has finish her work.
She said that she had finished her work.
She said that she finished my work yesterday.
questions.explanation: Have/has + V3 becomes had + V3, and “I” becomes “she”.

passage.text: Urban trees do more than improve the appearance of a city. They provide shade, reduce surface temperatures and can absorb some air pollutants. Trees also support birds and insects. However, poorly planned planting can damage pavements or interfere with overhead wires. Cities therefore need to choose suitable species and maintain them regularly.

questions.explanation: The passage lists benefits, then stresses planning and care.
questions.tip: The main idea covers the whole passage.
